question: restaurants inside Baixa-Chiado bbox
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category='restaurant' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.139,38.707,-9.124,38.718))

question: historic sites inside residential building footprints
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id, b.subtype FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.taxonomy.primary='historic_site' AND b.subtype='residential'

question: buildings intersecting Alfama bbox
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, subtype, class, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.130,38.710,-9.115,38.720))

question: commercial buildings containing open restaurants
sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.names.primary AS building_name, b.subtype FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE b.subtype='commercial' AND p.basic_category='restaurant' AND p.operating_status='open'

question: adjacent residential buildings in central Lisbon
sql: SELECT a.id AS building_a, b.id AS building_b FROM lisbon_buildings a JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON a.id < b.id AND ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.subtype='residential' AND b.subtype='residential' AND ST_Intersects(a.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.14,38.707,-9.12,38.72))

question: POIs inside Torre VTS de Algés footprint
sql: SELECT p.id, p.basic_category, p.names.primary AS name FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE b.names.primary='Torre VTS de Algés'
